caption: Evidence-bounded computational architecture. Public RGB and mesh-rendered depth feed observable geometry and quality gates; failed or unsupported cases are refused. Reference-dependent fill requires an explicit target policy. The final output is an offline surface-conformal plan; neither robot execution nor printing is authorized.
data_origin: Sealed result summaries and identified local public-data inputs.
limitations: Descriptive evidence only; correlated views/subsets are not independent subjects.
Synthetic mesh-rendered depth is not a physical sensor measurement.
